gtin.description: The GS1 GTIN identifying this level.

childGtin.description: The GTIN of the active lower level of this item; required above EACH, absent for EACH.

unitsPerPack.description: Eaches in one pack. 1 for EACH; at least 2 above it and a multiple (at least twice) of the child's.

grossWeightG.description: Gross weight in grams; at least the weight of the contents when the child's is known.
